_comment: Regression digest registry: one frozen digest per release-visible contract.
Generated by 'python tests/release_digests.py --write' from SPEC in that file; do not edit by hand.
tests/test_release.py checks it in-process against the test pins and in fresh interpreters; tools/check_release.py against the installed wheel.
Change an entry only with a deliberate bump of its owner version (docs/versioning.md, section 4) and a changelog entry.

baseline.fire-aware-shortest-path-v1.res.what: Record digests of every episode of the baseline development manifest (the baseline's actions).

benchmark.versions.what: sha256_hex(benchmark_versions()): every version that provenance pins, with its value.

cli.evaluation-manifest.file_sha256.what: SHA-256 of the file bytes of 'emberbench evaluation manifest --suite scenarios/public/v1 --seed 0 --seed 1 --seed 2'.

cli.version-json.stdout_sha256.owner: package version; CLI_VERSION; every version that 'emberbench version' reports
cli.version-json.stdout_sha256.what: SHA-256 of the stdout bytes of 'emberbench version --json'. The only entry that moves with the package version.

environment-pack.registry-public-v1.pack.owner: ENVIRONMENT_PACK_VERSION; every version in pack_versions(); SCHEMA_VERSION
environment-pack.registry-public-v1.pack.what: Digest of the pack frozen from the public suite and the schedule 4, 2, 6 (scenario bytes, schedule, versions, fire worlds).

environment-world.v1-pub-10-route-invali.what: environment_world_digest of the stochastic public scenario at seed 1 (unique-world identity).

evaluation.baseline-dev.result_file_sha2.what: SHA-256 of the evaluation result file of the baseline development manifest.

evaluation.public-v1-unique-worlds.manif.what: build_unique_world_manifest(public suite, candidate seeds 0..15, stochastic_worlds=10): no duplicate world.

generator.test-config.generation_hash.what: Generation record of the test-only config, seed and batch.

hazard.stochastic-golden-traces.what: sha256_hex of the recomputed list of stochastic golden fire traces.

integrity.test-run.provenance_digest.owner: INTEGRITY_PROTOCOL_VERSION; BENCHMARK_REVISION; every version in benchmark_versions()
integrity.test-run.provenance_digest.what: Provenance of the tests/test_integrity.py run fixture (test-only seeds and identity).

replay.route-invalidation-fire-aware-s1..what: SHA-256 of the animation JSON (with crowd overlay) of the fire-aware baseline on the stochastic public scenario, seed 1.
Replay audit digest (with crowd overlay) of the same episode.

rules.calibration.what: sha256_hex(calibration_rules()): panel, difficulty bands and admission thresholds.

rules.composition.rule_set_digest.what: Compatibility digest for records created under the formerly public research composition; it does not identify a current or future evaluation policy.

rules.family.what: sha256_hex(family_rules()): the ten V1 family rules and thresholds.

scoring.constants_digest.what: OFFICIAL_CONSTANTS.digest(): weights, thresholds and caps of the EMBER Score.

scoring.episode-score.route-invalidation.what: sha256_hex(score_episode(...).to_dict()) of the fire-aware baseline on the stochastic public scenario, seed 1.

scoring.score-report.registry-public-v1.what: Official ScoreReport digest of the fire-aware baseline on the registry pack (200 bootstrap resamples).

simulator.golden-record.one_person_one_e.what: Run record digest, greedy policy, deterministic fire.

simulator.golden-record.stochastic_room.what: Run record digest, greedy policy, stochastic fire.

statistics.aggregate.what: Aggregate statistics of the tiny fixed input.

statistics.paired.what: Paired statistics of the tiny fixed input.
